title: AP2 Mandate Input (UCP checkout)
description: Typed input boundary for the JACS AP2 merchant-authorization exporter (UCP AP2-Mandates extension, revision 2026-01-23). The exporter validates the checkout object against this schema and rejects anything else: a purpose-built content exporter takes a typed source, never arbitrary documents. The signed payload is this checkout object EXCLUDING the `ap2` field, canonicalized per RFC 8785 (JCS).

id.description: Checkout identifier assigned by the merchant/business endpoint.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all amounts in the checkout.

line_items.description: Items being authorized. Amounts are integer minor units per UCP.

ap2.description: AP2-Mandates extension block. EXCLUDED from the signed payload; the exporter writes the merchant_authorization detached JWS here.

merchant_authorization.description: Detached compact ES256 JWS (<BASE64URL(header)>..<BASE64URL(signature)>) emitted by the exporter.
